earakely-scale/GnoteFromRequestComputerEnv-REA

In Gnote, add olive oil to the Shopping List note; the app saves automatically.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • desktop computer-use evaluation
  • GUI-only editing task

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

A verifier script reads the app's saved files through a data view and passes only if every check holds, with no model.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

hf download earakely-scale/GnoteFromRequestComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir gnote-request
agent-env run gnote-request/bundle --task add-olive-oil --agent claude-code --model <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/GnoteFromRequestComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir GnoteFromRequestComputerEnv-REA

Needs: Docker.

Evidence

3 of 3 Claude Code runs passed and a witness run shows the task is doable through the GUI.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
